response.sql: SELECT COALESCE(o.orderbase, 'missing') as channel, AVG(oe.fillcount) as avg_filled_quantity, COUNT(*) as execution_count, COUNT(*) * 1.0 / SUM(COUNT(*)) OVER () as fraction_of_total FROM orders o INNER JOIN orderexecutions oe ON o.recordvault = oe.ordersmark GROUP BY o.orderbase ORDER BY channel
